translations.web: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor?” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
